memories.content: Khrushchev is the leader of the Soviet Union. He has authorized the placement of nuclear missiles in Cuba and is now facing a US quarantine. He is considering his options, including direct communication with President Kennedy. He has not yet decided whether to send a letter.

On October 22, 1962, President Kennedy delivered a televised address announcing a quarantine of Cuba to prevent further Soviet missile shipments. The world is now aware of the crisis. Diplomatic channels exist for direct communication between the leaders, including through their embassies and the White House–Kremlin teletype (the 'hotline' is not yet established, but letters can be sent via diplomatic pouch or cable).
